ranking_note: Authored from the description at base commit 3a1f7a172c, frozen before any rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Sibling gaming:setup is in this plugin (user-invoked only, disable-model-invocation true); no other installed plugin covers the DLSS 5 mod, so the near-miss negatives (setup phrasings, in-game DLSS settings, the NVIDIA App override, ReShade and Special K, general anti-cheat and driver questions) test quietness, not competitor wins. Positives paraphrase the actions rather than repeat the description's quoted phrases.
